### Added

- *(plans)* Hive merges Plans, Roadmap and the magazine in [#2743](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2743) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(gs)* Show worker CPU and memory capacity of clusters in [#2736](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2736) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)

### Changed

- *(repositories)* Reach Create repository only from the Repositories page in [#2741](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2741) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians)

### Fixed

- *(scaffolder)* Refresh cluster tokens when a template is submitted in [#2735](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2735) by [@QuentinBisson](https://github.com/QuentinBisson)
- *(gs)* Keep the sidebar without a main auth provider in [#2742](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2742) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(deps)* Update dependency @bufbuild/protobuf to v2.15.0 in [#2733](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2733) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- *(backend)* Warn at startup when the telemetry app ID is empty in [#2746](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2746) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(agent-platform)* Read delete_cluster's nothingLeft as removal done in [#2753](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2753) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(gs)* Open the cluster page of a cluster a HelmRelease installs in [#2754](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2754) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(app)* Skip TelemetryDeck on an empty app ID, log init failures in [#2756](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2756) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(backend)* Retry the database at start, exit on a failed boot in [#2757](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2757) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v2.91.1...v2.92.0-rc.8
